# The tree-column accessibility notes precede its JSDoc tag

This local repair moves @augments below the two prose notes in MozTreecolImage JSDoc. It keeps the label-versus-alt explanation intact and changes no executable widget code. Accepted source retains that order. The historical parser report explains the repair context; no lint or accessibility run was performed, and this example does not define a repository-wide tag-order rule.

Scope: Tree-column widget class documentation.
